crop.notes: Allen item is the short 'Sporting Notes' notice at the top; the rest of the clipping is an unrelated Criminal Record story about a swindler, George Freiboth.

ocr.notes: Allen notice reads correctly; swindle story has scattered errors.

title.suggested: Allen Advertises Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, September 3, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening and billing himself as retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: The notice is entirely about Allen, so primary for that item although it is only a paid-style notice; the same notice runs again in 862.
